description.value: Steiner Bakery & Coffee Shop has been a Campbell River institution for over 30 years, with a Swiss-trained baker producing artisan breads, European-style pastries, handcrafted chocolates, and made-to-order specialty cakes. The in-house coffee shop is a popular lunch destination offering scratch-made chowder, daily soup specials, and gourmet sandwiches alongside organic coffee. It bills itself as a destination for Northern Vancouver Island, serving communities from Campbell River to Courtenay.
